seoTitle: How to Center Text Vertically in Google Docs (2026)
metaDescription: Center text both horizontally and vertically in Google Docs using toolbar alignment and a borderless table trick for perfectly balanced titles.
intro: Horizontal centering is a one-click toolbar action, but vertical centering takes a small workaround since Google Docs has no direct vertical alignment tool for the page. This guide covers both: standard horizontal centering, plus wrapping text inside a borderless table cell set to vertical center alignment, which is the go-to trick for title pages, flyers, and certificates.

steps.heading: Apply horizontal centering
steps.body: Highlight your text and use the toolbar's center alignment icon, or press Control+Shift+E or Command+Shift+E, to center it across the page.

steps.heading: Insert a single-cell table
steps.body: Wrap your text inside a single-cell table to create a structural boundary container you can control independently.

steps.heading: Open Table Properties
steps.body: Right-click the table and open Table Properties to access the sidebar management panel.

steps.heading: Set vertical alignment to Center
steps.body: In the cell settings, change the vertical alignment option from Top to Center so your text balances up and down within the cell.

steps.heading: Hide the table border
steps.body: Set the bounding line weight to zero points to make the table frame invisible while keeping the alignment effect.

steps.heading: Check the final balance
steps.body: Run a visual check across your title page or flyer to confirm the text reads as perfectly centered both directions.

faq.question: Is there a direct way to vertically center a page in Google Docs?
faq.answer: No, Google Docs doesn't have a native page-level vertical centering tool, so the borderless table method is the standard workaround.

faq.question: Will the invisible table show up if I print the document?
faq.answer: No, once the border weight is set to zero points, the table frame becomes invisible both on screen and in print.

faq.question: Can I center multiple paragraphs vertically using this method?
faq.answer: Yes, you can place multiple lines or paragraphs inside the same table cell, and they'll all align to the vertical center together.

faq.question: Does this method work well for certificate templates?
faq.answer: Yes, it's commonly used for certificates, event flyers, and title pages where text needs to sit precisely centered on the page.
